newsitem.title: POLAND: Amerbank to lead loan for gas project.
newsitem.headline: Amerbank to lead loan for gas project.

text.p: Poland's Bank Amerykanski w Polsce Amerbank SA signed an agreement on Thursday to lead a five-bank consortium to finance the construction of the Polish part of the Yamal natural gas pipeline, Amerbank said.

The bank said in a statement that Europol Gaz SA, which is building the Polish section, would receive loans from a consortium including Bank Gospodarstwa Krajowego and Bank Rozwoju Exportu SA (BRE), Powszechny Bank Gospodarczy SA and Raiffeisen Centrobank SA.
Amerbank gave no figure on the loans.
Last week Bank Gdanski SA announced it would lead a consortium of three banks to lend 56 million zlotys to Europol to finance the land purchases needed for the Polish section of the pipeline.
